MORE GOSSIP P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. LAURENCE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P38](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0038), [v5 CHAPTER XXVI. - [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) — Spouse of — [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) — fiancé, soon to be married · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXXV. “LET THE PIPER COME” P7](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0007)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Miss Winifred and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) visit [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) at [Hollowmere](../codex/places.md#hollowmere) to discuss Myra Murray's funeral and church gossip. They debate the nature of the afterlife and discuss various church members, including Mrs. [Hector](../character/hector.md) Twiss's threat to withhold her subscription, before sending [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) to [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), where she tells [Grace Ashdown](../character/grace.md) about the potential financial troubles facing her father's parish.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P0](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P9](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P23](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P34](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0034)_

> [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) walks through [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) on his way to propose to [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md), reflecting on his feelings for her and his reluctance to take a "suitable" second wife. Meanwhile, [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) prepares to hold [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) to a past vow to reject him despite their fond mutual regard, leaving [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) anxious about turning him down.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P0](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P1](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P12](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0012), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015)_

> [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) returns home from a party after seeing [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) and pondering her feelings. Upon arriving, [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) reveals that [John Ashdown](../character/john-ashdown.md) proposed to her and asks [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) to release her from her vow never to abandon her. [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) steadfastly refuses, compelling [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) to send Ashdown a cold written rejection, leaving both [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) and Ashdown heartbroken.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXII. ST. LAURENCE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. LAURENCE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. LAURENCE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P11](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. LAURENCE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P21](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0021), [v5 CHAPTER XXII. ST. LAURENCE KNOWS ALL ABOUT IT P41](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0041)_

> [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) confronts [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) and asks her to release her sister [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) from a vow so they can marry, which [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) willingly grants. Afterwards, [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) returns home and informs [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) of her consent, but [Harriet](../character/harriet-ainslie.md) insists she will not marry Lionel if [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) refuses to come live with them.
>
